item.title: Judge chastises Trump administration plan to push ahead overhaul of DC golf course
item.description: The Trump administration wants to turn a historic public golf course into championship links. Despite a judge's order, hundreds of trees were cut down to make way for the renovation.
item.content:encoded:
The Trump administration wants to turn a historic public golf course into championship links. Despite a judge's order, hundreds of trees were cut down to make way for the renovation.

(Image credit: Tasos Katopodis)

item.title: A Kelvin wave raised sea levels on the West Coast. More are coming
item.description: A large underwater wave moved up the West Coast, raising sea levels. Scientists say it's driven by El Niño and it's going to happen again.
item.content:encoded:
A large underwater wave moved up the West Coast, raising sea levels. Scientists say it's driven by El Niño and it's going to happen again.

item.title: Activists decry the clearing 250-year-old trees for border wall expansion
item.description: Protesters in Arizona are decrying the removal of 250-year-old cottonwood trees for border wall expansion. This after a judge temporarily halted it in and near Big Bend National Park in Texas.

item.title: Trump to close and renovate D.C. golf course, despite legal battle
item.description: President Trump continues his efforts to remake Washington, D.C. He wants to turn an area used by the public into a world-class golf course.

item.title: Disgruntled farmers may help flip Senate seat in Kansas
item.description: President Trump heads to Kansas to campaign for Republican candidates Monday but farmers disgruntled by White House policies may help flip a U.S. Senate seat that Republicans have held for almost a century.

item.title: Zoe Kazan on her adaptation of Steinbeck's East of Eden - and her grandfather's
item.description: Screenwriter Zoe Kazan talks about her adaptation of John Steinbeck's 1952 novel – a sprawling multigenerational epic that explores the nature of good and evil - streaming now on Netflix.

item.title: Dad shift: Men now file majority of paid family leave claims in key states
item.description: The U.S. has no law guaranteeing paid parental leave. But in states with their own programs, more dads are using the benefit to bond with their new children, exceeding moms in some states.

item.title: Iowa's vote in midterms may help determine balance of power in Congress
item.description: Iowa Public Radio's Natalie Krebs reports on how Iowa - a state that reliably votes Republican for president - has some competitive races for Republicans in November, which could help determine the balance of power in Congress.

item.title: President Trump's widening stamp on D.C. landmarks
